まずプロジェクトルートのskillsを削除ください。これは各種パッケージに追加され不要になりました。
phpstan-ai-formatterのdocsを削除しguardのno-docsnのルールを適用ください。README.mdなども規約に沿ってなくguard利用がまともにできていなさそうに見えます。phpunit-ai-reporterも同様です。
README.mdに関しては各パッケージちょっとおかしいです。guard-phpのデフォルトルールの適用系にして確認いただけますか？また逆にPJルートのREADMEはこう書かないルールの認識です。

docsとしてはdocgen/guard/phpstan-guard-rulesだけが持ちます。それ以外は持ちません。AGENTS.mdなども壊れているので修正ください。
各パッケージの構成とguard-phpの標準ルールを確認し、不要なskills・docsの削除、READMEと設定の修正を進めます。AGENTS.mdは上書き禁止の指示があるため、まず参照切れと必要な変更を確認します。

既存の変更があり、GuardとDocGenのスキル移行が進んでいました。この変更を引き継いで整理します。Guardパッケージの`guard`スキルに従い、同梱ルールと実際の検査結果を確認します。

AGENTS.mdも修正するという今回の明示指示に基づき、古い参照と構成を更新します。

原因が分かりました。各パッケージのguard設定はREADMEのタイトルだけを検査していて、標準の`readme-md`ルールを読み込んでいませんでした。ルートREADMEも、標準ルールのモノレポ向け構成から外れています。

全パッケージに標準READMEルールを適用し、ルートはパッケージ一覧中心に直します。docs禁止の同梱ルール名は`disable-doc`なので、formatter・reporterとルートに適用します。

+# guard-php
+
+[![PHP](https://img.shields.io/badge/php-8.0%2B-777bb4?logo=php&logoColor=white)](https://www.php.net/)
+[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](../../LICENSE)
+
+Check and repair PHP project policies for source metrics, directory structure,
+Markdown documents, and tool configuration. Part of [php-ai-toolkit](../../README.md).
+
+## Requirements
+
+- PHP 8.0 or later with the DOM extension.
+- Composer.
+
+## Getting Started
+
+From a local checkout, register the packages in the consuming project, then install Guard:
+
+```sh
+composer config repositories.php-ai-toolkit path '../php-ai-toolkit/packages/*'
+composer config minimum-stability dev
+composer config prefer-stable true
+composer require --dev k-kinzal/guard-php:dev-main
+vendor/bin/guard init
+vendor/bin/guard rules
+vendor/bin/guard check
+vendor/bin/guard fix --dry-run
+vendor/bin/guard fix
+```
+
+Adjust the checkout path for your project. Review the policy generated by `init`;
+required violations fail the check, while recommendations warn. Configuration
+fields can be repaired automatically; source, directory, and Markdown findings
+need manual changes.
+
+When the project has no `docs/` directory, `init` imports `disable-doc` to prevent
+creating one. For an existing policy, add
+`vendor/k-kinzal/guard-php/rules/disable-doc.yaml` to `imports`.
+
+## Documentation
+
+- [Policies](docs/policies.md): Checks, repairs, and adoption.
+- [Command Line](docs/cli.md): Commands, options, reports, and exit codes.
+- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): Imports, overrides, presets, and scope.
+- [Metrics](docs/metrics.md): PHP line and complexity limits.
+- [Structure](docs/structure.md): Directory contents, naming, and count constraints.
+- [Documents](docs/documents.md): Markdown outlines, badges, and content rules.
+- [Configuration Fields](docs/fields.md): Field assertions and repairs.
+- [Extensions](docs/extensions.md): Custom policies and structures.
+
+The [guard skill](skills/guard/SKILL.md) covers CLI usage, policy changes, and GitHub Actions.
+
+## License
+
+[MIT](../../LICENSE)

+# phpstan-ai-formatter
+
+[![PHP](https://img.shields.io/badge/php-8.0%2B-777bb4?logo=php&logoColor=white)](https://www.php.net/)
+[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](../../LICENSE)
+
+Format PHPStan diagnostics for coding agents and humans through the `ai` error
+formatter. Part of [php-ai-toolkit](../../README.md).
+
+## Requirements
+
+- PHP 8.0 or later.
+- PHPStan `^1.12 || ^2.0`.
+- Composer.
+
+## Installation
+
+From a local checkout, register the packages in the consuming project:
+
+```sh
+composer config repositories.php-ai-toolkit path '../php-ai-toolkit/packages/*'
+composer config minimum-stability dev
+composer config prefer-stable true
+composer require --dev k-kinzal/phpstan-ai-formatter:dev-main
+```
+
+Adjust the checkout path for your project. Composer also installs
+`phpunit-ai-reporter`, which provides the shared agent detector.
+
+## Usage
+
+Include the extension in `phpstan.neon`:
+
+```neon
+includes:
+    - vendor/k-kinzal/phpstan-ai-formatter/extension.neon
+```
+
+The extension selects `errorFormat: ai`. If `phpstan/extension-installer` already
+loads it, omit the explicit include. Run your usual analysis:
+
+```sh
+vendor/bin/phpstan analyse
+```
+
+## Output
+
+Recognized coding-agent environments select compact AI output automatically.
+Set a non-empty `AI_AGENT` value to select it explicitly:
+
+```sh
+AI_AGENT=1 vendor/bin/phpstan analyse
+```
+
+AI output includes project-relative locations, rule identifiers, messages, source
+lines, and available tips. When an identifier occurs at least three times,
+file-specific findings are grouped by identifier. Human output groups findings
+by file and adds terminal source context and colors.
+
+Both modes report the same findings and preserve PHPStan's exit status: `0` for
+no errors, including warning-only results, and `1` when errors exist.
+
+## License
+
+[MIT](../../LICENSE)

+# phpunit-ai-reporter
+
+[![PHP](https://img.shields.io/badge/php-8.0%2B-777bb4?logo=php&logoColor=white)](https://www.php.net/)
+[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](../../LICENSE)
+
+Report PHPUnit failures for coding agents and humans, and run PHPDoc examples
+as PHPUnit tests with Doctest. Part of [php-ai-toolkit](../../README.md).
+
+## Requirements
+
+- PHP 8.0 or later.
+- PHPUnit `^9.6 || ^10.5 || ^11 || ^12 || ^13`, compatible with your PHP runtime.
+- Composer.
+
+## Installation
+
+From a local checkout, register the packages in the consuming project:
+
+```sh
+composer config repositories.php-ai-toolkit path '../php-ai-toolkit/packages/*'
+composer config minimum-stability dev
+composer config prefer-stable true
+composer require --dev k-kinzal/phpunit-ai-reporter:dev-main
+```
+
+Adjust the checkout path for your project. Install a compatible PHPUnit release
+if your project does not already require one.
+
+## Usage
+
+For PHPUnit 10.5 or later, add the reporter to `phpunit.xml.dist` alongside your
+existing extensions:
+
+```xml
+<extensions>
+    <bootstrap class="Toolkit\PhpUnit\TestReporter\AiTestReporterExtension"/>
+</extensions>
+```
+
+For PHPUnit 9.6, use its listener API instead:
+
+```xml
+<listeners>
+    <listener class="Toolkit\PhpUnit\TestReporter\Legacy\LegacyAiTestReporterListener"/>
+</listeners>
+```
+
+Run `vendor/bin/phpunit`. The [PHPUnit setup skill](skills/setup-toolkit-phpunit/SKILL.md)
+includes version-specific templates and strict configuration guidance.
+
+## Reporter Output
+
+Recognized coding-agent environments select AI output automatically; a non-empty
+`AI_AGENT` value selects it explicitly. The report includes failures, unexpected
+errors, and risky tests with locations, messages, source lines, and available diffs.
+PHPUnit continues to report warnings, skipped tests, and incomplete tests.
+
+On PHPUnit 10.5 or later, AI mode replaces progress and result output. The PHPUnit
+9.6 listener adds its report to standard error. Human mode retains PHPUnit's
+normal output and adds source context for issues on standard error. The reporter
+disables itself when the `PARATEST` environment marker is present.
+
+## Doctest
+
+Doctest runs PHPDoc `@example` blocks and PHP fenced examples as tests. Add the
+shipped suite and extension on PHPUnit 10.5 or later:
+
+```xml
+<testsuites>
+    <testsuite name="doctest">
+        <file>vendor/k-kinzal/phpunit-ai-reporter/src/Doctest/DoctestSuite.php</file>
+    </testsuite>
+</testsuites>
+<extensions>
+    <bootstrap class="Toolkit\Doctest\DoctestExtension">
+        <parameter name="directories" value="src"/>
+    </bootstrap>
+</extensions>
+```
+
+Merge these entries with your existing suites and extensions. Run examples with
+`vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite doctest`. The [Doctest setup skill](skills/setup-toolkit-doctest/SKILL.md)
+covers PHPUnit 9.6 setup, scan roots, assertion notation, and filtering examples.
+
+## License
+
+[MIT](../../LICENSE)
*** End Patch"));
